partial_progress.details: Phase 3 (countermodel/Hintikka re-verification under the Sfor-containment dedup) is BLOCKED. Enumerated all relevant lemmas (IBranchSaturation.sat_fimp, sfSatisfied/IExpandedConsistent, IExpandedConsistent_sat, intExpandBranches_openBranch_sat, openBranch_countermodel). Found that intFImpReuseWitness? (Expansion.lean:248-267, Phase 2's dedup predicate) guarantees T(phi)@x at a reuse witness x but does NOT guarantee the explicit F(psi)@x branch entry that IBranchSaturation.sat_fimp/sfSatisfied's .neg/.imp case requires -- propagatePersistence only ever copies .pos-signed formulas, so a reuse witness can lack any signed entry for psi whatsoever. Constructed a concrete hand-traced counterexample (Atom=Nat, a 2-entry bPers, a reuse witness x=1 chosen for F(atomQ->atomP)@0 despite bPers having no F(atomP)@1 entry anywhere). Per the plan's own contingency for this exact scenario, did NOT weaken sfSatisfied/IBranchSaturation/any countermodel lemma to compensate; instead marked Phase 3 [BLOCKED] in the plan file and recommended a Phase 1/2 tightening of intFImpReuseWitness? (require an explicit F(psi)@x entry, not merely psi not-forced-at-x). No Scheme.lean edit was made (any edit would have required a new sorry or a forbidden weakening). Zero new sorries, zero new axioms, zero vacuous definitions -- Scheme.lean is byte-identical to the 26508fe9 baseline. Also noted (informational, separate from the R2 blocker): intExpandBranches_openBranch_sat's succ case is independently stale relative to the current post-dedup go definition (does not yet case-split on newEdge/intFImpReuseWitness? at all) and will need repair alongside the predicate fix. Recorded the task-430 accessibility-structure coordination note as instructed.
